newsitem.title: GERMANY: Integrators up Cologne air cargo 11.5 pct in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Integrators up Cologne air cargo 11.5 pct in 1996.

text.p: Cologne Airport (CGN) increased air cargo volumes by 11.5 percent to 356,290 tonnes in 1996, airport authority Flughafen Koeln/Bonn GmbH said.
Strong growth in freighter services operated by express integrators such as UPS, TNT Worldwide Express as well as by Deutsche Lufthansa AG generated the bulk of growth, an authority report showed.
Total flown freight rose 14.6 percent to 322,521 tonnes with freighter services carrying 95 percent of this, the report showed.
Exports rose 15.1 percent to 157,234 tonnes while imports increased 13.3 percent to 168,431.
Trucked cargo fell 12.4 percent to 33,769 tonnes, the airport report said. --Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel:44-171-542-7706 Fax: 5017
